# The Day After AI

Making Software Companies Legible to AI Agents

Author: Enrico Piovesan
Publisher: Apress
ISBN: 9798868834516

Companion site: https://thedayafteraibook.com/
C-DAD white paper: https://enricopiovesan.com/whitepapers/c-dad/

The cdad command-line tool documented on this site is a companion product. The book does not cover the CLI.

## Book structure

- Part 0: Monday Morning (Opening Scene): https://thedayafteraibook.com/excerpt/
- Introduction: https://thedayafteraibook.com/introduction/
- Part I: The Problem
  - Chapter 1: The Day After. The industry changed. Most companies didn't notice what changed. https://thedayafteraibook.com/the-day-after/
  - Chapter 2: Tribal Knowledge Is the Bottleneck. Everything your company knows is buried. Here's exactly where. https://thedayafteraibook.com/tribal-knowledge/
- Part II: The Architecture
  - Chapter 3: Contracts Are the Answer. Not documentation. Not better wikis. Contracts. https://thedayafteraibook.com/contracts/
  - Chapter 4: Capability Graphs, the New Atomic Unit. Stop thinking in services. Start thinking in capabilities. https://thedayafteraibook.com/capabilities-graph/
  - Chapter 5: Extraction Over Refactoring. Don't fix the legacy system. Extract from it. https://thedayafteraibook.com/extraction-over-refactoring/
  - Chapter 6: Making Your System Legible to AI Agents. The technical model for agent-navigable architecture https://thedayafteraibook.com/making-your-system-legible/
- Part III: The Transformation
  - Chapter 7: The Architect. From execution overhead to judgment at scale https://thedayafteraibook.com/for-architects/
  - Chapter 8: The Developer. From coder to software engineer https://thedayafteraibook.com/for-developers/
  - Chapter 9: The PM / PO. From story author to contract author https://thedayafteraibook.com/for-product-managers/
  - Chapter 10: The Designer. From visual author to behavioral contract author https://thedayafteraibook.com/for-designers/
  - Chapter 11: Leadership. Most companies will get the velocity. Few will get the value. https://thedayafteraibook.com/for-engineering-leaders/
  - Chapter 12: The Company That Gets There First. What winning looks like, and what it compounds into https://thedayafteraibook.com/company-that-gets-there-first/
- Appendix A: The C-DAD Specification. https://thedayafteraibook.com/appendix/c-dad-specification/
- Appendix B: MCP Documentation and Implementation Resources. https://thedayafteraibook.com/appendix/mcp-documentation-and-implementation-resources/
- Appendix C: The Agent Onboarding Test. https://thedayafteraibook.com/appendix/agent-onboarding-test/
- Appendix D: The Interaction Contract Template. https://thedayafteraibook.com/appendix/interaction-contract-template/

About the book: https://thedayafteraibook.com/about-the-book/
